# Changelog is generated by git-cliff

## Context

Hand-written release paragraphs drift from the commits. jekyll-theme-modootoday's releasing notes ask a person to fill a summary paragraph. That step is not adopted.

## Decision

Conventional Commits in English are the only changelog input. git-cliff writes Keep a Changelog sections. A `Changelog: none` footer skips a commit. Nobody edits the generated list by hand.

## Consequences

Release notes are the changelog section for that version. If the section is empty, the workflow falls back to commit subjects since the previous `v*` tag.
